correctness.rationale: The proof normalizes every overlapping lax cover without increasing the relative deletion fraction. Counting excluded cross cells gives the exact fiber score and deterministic decision criterion. Uniform averaging yields the sharp universal p_{r,s}; equality of every fiber score forces complete rectangular occupied fibers. Boundary cases p=0,1 and empty teams are included. A standalone exhaustive program independently checks all 848 subteams on four domains, all overlapping covers, eight threshold decisions and extremal configurations. The checks are finite evidence only, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Approximate functional dependence is motivated by noisy databases, and a recent paper shows mixed approximate/exact disjunctions can be NP-complete. This theorem identifies a natural common-determinant tractability island, gives the exact per-team test and optimal error fraction, and proves a sharp all-alphabet worst-case threshold with a complete extremizer classification. The exact rectangular worst cases explain what robust tolerance is necessary; the result is not just finite experiments, a renaming, or a p=0 corollary.
